card.name: End of missed-dose instructions
card.fires_on: The period or semicolon that ends a sentence telling the reader to skip a missed dose and resume at the next scheduled time. It comes right before a "do not double the dose" instruction.

modes.label: Missed-dose sentence end
modes.description: Period or semicolon closing the instruction to take the next dose at the regular time.
modes.example: skip the missed dose and take the next dose at the regular time<<.>> Do not take two doses of duloxetine

modes.label: Swallow whole semicolon
modes.description: Semicolon after an instruction to swallow tablets whole, before a do-not-chew warning.
modes.example: Swallow VOQUEZNA tablets whole<<;>> do not chew or crush the tablet.

modes.label: Inside cautionary wording
modes.description: Occasional firing inside drug names or emphatic caution phrases in dosing text.
modes.example: EXTRE<<ME>> CAUTION should be exercised when administering dopamine

card.writes: It suppresses "should" and "recommended" style words, so the next text is a plain directive rather than advisory wording.
card.plain: It marks the end of a missed-dose instruction, just before a plain "do not double up" sentence.
